settings.title: Initiative settings
settings.subtitle: Update details, manage members and roles, and control dangerous actions.
settings.notFoundDescription: The initiative you’re looking for doesn’t exist or you no longer have access.
settings.permissionRequiredDescription: Only community admins and initiative project managers can manage initiative settings.

joinPolicy.title: Joining
joinPolicy.description: Who in this community can join this initiative, and how. Joining decides what someone can see — sharing still governs each item inside.
joinPolicy.privateHelp: Hidden from the community directory. Project managers add members by hand.
joinPolicy.requestHelp: Listed in the community directory. Members ask to join and a project manager approves.
joinPolicy.openHelp: Listed in the community directory. Any community member can join themselves, with view-only access to start.

autoJoin.label: Add every new community member automatically
autoJoin.help: Anyone who joins this community from now on becomes a member of this initiative, with view-only access to start.
autoJoin.notRetroactive: People already in the community are not added — they can join this initiative themselves from the community directory.
autoJoin.requiresOpen: Auto-join needs the “Anyone can join” policy above. An initiative nobody can enter on their own should not enrol people automatically — anyone who left could never get back in.
autoJoin.lockedNote: A community admin turned on auto-join for this initiative, so it has to stay open to everyone. Ask an admin to turn auto-join off before changing this.
autoJoin.turnedOff: Auto-join is off — it is only available while anyone can join.

settings.membersDescription: Initiative project managers and community admins can manage membership.

settings.removeMemberError: Unable to remove member right now.
settings.roleUpdateError: Unable to update role right now.
settings.rolesDescription: Configure what each role can do within this initiative. Project Manager permissions are locked to prevent accidental lockouts.
settings.fullAccessDescription: Overrides item sharing: this role can open and edit every item in the initiative even when it isn't shared with them, and can manage who else has access.
settings.dangerDescription: Deleting an initiative removes all of its projects, tasks, and documents.
settings.archiveDescription: Hide this initiative from the sidebar for everyone. Nothing is deleted — you can unarchive it any time.
settings.archivedDescription: This initiative is archived and hidden from the sidebar.
settings.defaultCannotDelete: The default initiative cannot be deleted.
settings.contactAdmin: Contact a community admin to delete this initiative.
settings.deleteError: Unable to delete initiative right now.
settings.deleteConfirmDescription: <bold>{{name}}</bold> and everything inside it (projects, tasks, documents, queues, events) will be sent to the trash. You can restore the whole tree from Settings → Trash before the retention period ends.
settings.createRoleDescription: Add a new role with custom permissions for this initiative.
settings.roleInternalNameHint: Lowercase, no spaces. Used internally for identification.
settings.deleteRoleDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the role "{{roleName}}"? This action cannot be undone.
settings.renameRoleDescription: Change the display name for the "{{roleName}}" role.
settings.removeMemberDescription: Are you sure you want to remove <bold>{{name}}</bold> from this initiative?

settings.roleNameRequired: Name and display name are required.

advancedToolsDescription: Enable optional tools for this initiative.
queuesFeatureDescription: Organize items by priority, track turn order, and manage who goes next.
calendarsFeatureDescription: Organize events into shareable calendars with attendees and RSVP tracking.
dashboardsFeatureDescription: Build a canvas of charts, KPIs, and timelines that displays existing work — a dashboard never edits the data it shows.
counterGroupsFeatureDescription: Track numeric values like HP, scores, or budgets — clamped, stepped, and shown as numbers, bars, or radial gauges.
postsFeatureDescription: A bulletin board for the initiative — notices everyone can read, comment on and react to, with the important ones pinned to the top.
